title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.00094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness region

translated_title: Nous：在信源校准之前学习与认证记忆决策
translated_abstract: 基于信念的智能体记忆需要对当前状态做出可靠决策，然而其证据可能是有噪声的、被复制的或过时的。记忆系统是否必须先校准其信源才能改进其决策？本文将学习、校准与修订认证这三个问题分离开来。在一个包含四个模型的隐马尔可夫模型族上，学习未知的贝叶斯决策需要 Θ(l^-2) 条记录，而认证其相对于信息性在位决策的改进只需要来自同一观测规律的 O(l^-2) 条新记录；相比之下，当持续性参数 l 趋于零时，达到固定精度的信源估计需要 Θ(l^-4) 条记录。因此，学习并认证有用的决策所需的记录数量可以比信源校准少一个平方量级。在更广泛的模型类别中，决策学习速率与信源估计下界仍然保持。在未知的“恒等加背景”报告信道下，本文刻画了策略改进的尖锐可识别区间，并利用可观测的见证区域推导出有限样本认证。
tldr: 本文证明了在隐马尔可夫模型下，智能体记忆系统学习并认证决策改进只需 Θ(l^-2) 条记录，而信源校准需要 Θ(l^-4) 条，表明记忆决策的改进无需先完成信源校准，且该结论在未知报告信道下仍可通过可观测见证区域实现有限样本认证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that learning and certifying memory decision improvements requires only Θ(l^-2) records compared to Θ(l^-4) for source calibration, showing that memory decisions can be improved without first calibrating sources, with finite-sample certification achievable via observable witness regions under unknown report channels.
